end.summary:
Practised top, front, and side views of solid objects.
Identified views of balls, cones, cylinders, books, coins, cups, lids, pitches, and dice.
Explained that the same object can look different from different places.
Initially said a handle would be visible from both positions; corrected this after considering the cup body blocking it.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised naming and matching top, front, and side views using familiar objects. They used shape clues such as round, triangle, rectangle, and square, and explained several answers with reasons. There was a mix-up about whether another person could see a cup handle, and they corrected it by noticing that the cup body could block the handle. At home, place a cup, book, or box in different positions and ask Reyansh what each person would see.
